hero.title: Settings
hero.desc: Manage your Gemini Key, voice experience, and backups in one place. Teacher, Story, and Fortune share one key.

memory.title: Memory
memory.tagline: On by default · Turn off anytime
memory.intro: Crew Teachers and Friends can remember conversations. Data stays in this browser, but relevant memories may be shared with Gemini in future conversations. Turning memory off stops further use and collection; it does not delete saved memories.
memory.personalDesc: Remember learning goals, interests, and preferences for Crew Teachers and Friends.
memory.friendDesc: Each friend and learning language has separate topics. Turning this off stops saving and reusing them.
memory.footnote: Previously disabled settings stay off. Manage or delete existing memories in your Teacher's knowledge or each Friend's shared memories.

backup.title: Data backup
backup.intro: Download stories, learning progress, and saved readings before switching devices or clearing browser data. Keep the backup private. Gemini API keys are never included.
backup.exportSuccess: Backup ready: {{stories}} stories and {{keys}} local entries.
backup.exportError: Backup failed. Check browser storage and try again.
backup.importSuccess: Imported {{stories}} stories and {{entries}} entries; skipped {{skipped}} existing entries. Refresh to update the screen.
backup.footnote: Imports only add missing data. Existing stories and keys are not replaced.

gemini.initialPending: Gemini Key saved, not yet verified.
gemini.keyEmpty: Paste a Gemini API Key first.
gemini.invalid: Invalid Key or insufficient API permission ({{status}})
gemini.keyError: Key unchanged: {{reason}}. Your existing key was kept.
gemini.storageError: Google verified the key, but it could not be saved in this browser. Check storage and try again.
gemini.keySaved: ✓ Gemini Key verified and saved (voice test optional)
gemini.verifiedDesc: Google API verification passed; voice can be tested separately
gemini.unverifiedDesc: Verify this key without granting microphone access
gemini.intro: Teacher, Story, and Fortune share one key. Save it after Google verification; microphone permission is not required.
gemini.step1Desc: Sign in with your Google account.
gemini.step2Desc: Create and copy a Gemini API Key.
gemini.step3Desc: Verify and save. Test voice separately if needed.
gemini.privacy: Your key stays in this browser. Usage and charges are managed in your Google project.
gemini.voiceTagline: Separate test · Saved Key stays intact
gemini.voiceIntro: Microphone permission is only required for voice features. A valid key does not necessarily mean Gemini Live will connect.
gemini.micStateUnsupported: This browser cannot query permission state
gemini.macHelp: Mac: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and allow Microsoft Edge / Chrome. Also allow this site in your browser's address-bar permissions. Quit and reopen the browser after changing the system setting.
gemini.windowsHelp: Windows: Open Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone. Allow microphone and desktop app access, then allow this site in Edge / Chrome.
gemini.genericHelp: Enable microphone access for your browser in system privacy settings and in this site's permissions, then try again.
gemini.voiceDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your device and site settings. Your saved key has not changed.
gemini.voiceMissing: No microphone found. Check your input device. Your saved key has not changed.
gemini.voiceError: Gemini Live test failed: {{reason}}. Your saved key has not changed.
gemini.diagnosticsDesc: Microphone API support does not mean your system has granted permission. Only the 'Check microphone' button requests access.
